tools.name: scan_domain
tools.description: Passive, read-only check of a public domain: DNS, TLS certificate and security headers. Refuses names that are not public.

tools.name: insurance_pack
tools.description: Cyber-insurance questionnaire pack for a public domain: answers the questions a passive scan can see (email authentication, DMARC, HTTPS, HSTS) and names the evidence an MSP attaches for the rest.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: What this company sells, who it is for, and every agent/API entry point. No account needed.

tools.name: list_pricing
tools.description: Current plans and prices in USD: plan, interval, amount_usd, currency, what_you_get. No account needed.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Checkout URL for a plan. With no arguments: the main paid plan. Where the site supports it the URL is a Stripe-hosted Checkout session (created unpaid; a human pays, nothing is charged by this tool). A free plan is only returned when the plan is requested or the company sells nothing else.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Find pages on this site by keyword; returns url, title and summary.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_checkout_link, search_site · Public sink: insurance_pack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_checkout_link, search_site · Public sink: insurance_pack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
